page.layout: One printed page (left) with a large woodcut plan of the Tabernacle in the centre of the page, labelled with compass directions and measurements; running head and page number at top; faint text of the main column surrounds the plan; a narrow column of text at the right edge belongs to the facing page, which is not transcribed.
page.notes: The page is mostly a woodcut plan of the tabernacle court with the furnishings (candlestick, altar of incense, table, laver, altar of burnt offering) and labels a, b. The faint running text beneath and around the plan is too damaged and washed out to transcribe reliably, so it is omitted. Labels on the plan are reproduced as printed; the letters a and b mark the inner altar and the pillar. The right-hand strip belongs to the facing page and is not transcribed.
